# Yantra4D

Compact LLM context index for this repository.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions.
- `README.md` — human/product overview when present.
- `ECOSYSTEM.md` — MADFAM ecosystem and Enclii deployment context when present.
- `llms-full.txt` — full context map and durable operating contract.

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first. Use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools. Direct `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs,
`docker exec`, or direct container access is bootstrap/break-glass only.

## Render release integrity

[Cache identity and artifact storage](docs/operations/render-artifact-storage.md#cache-identity-across-releases) documents API/worker and Studio build namespaces, manifest revalidation and the limits of project-load invalidation. [README](README.md) is the platform overview. Keep runtime revision metadata separate from authored commons manifests.

Shared configuration links preserve Unicode text through JSON escapes and retain legacy decoding. See the [share-link contract and limits](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md#shareable-urls).

Viewer artifact loading has independent completion and lifecycle guarantees. See [blank-viewer diagnostics and shared STL task ownership](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md#blank-viewer--no-stl); render completion alone does not prove canvas delivery.

## Native render output

[Native renderer output and cancellation](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md#native-renderer-stalls-after-substantial-output) explains pipe draining, per-request process ownership, deadlines and remaining isolation limits.

[Mode-specific controls](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md#controls-that-do-not-affect-the-selected-mode) documents the commons-owned visibility contract and actual-pin fastener regression.

[Native dropdown values](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md#numeric-dropdowns-change-native-geometry) retain the declared numeric or string option type; direct CLI comparisons must also match the platform checkbox encoding.

## Related repositories and contracts

- hyperobjects-spec: [README](https://github.com/madfam-org/hyperobjects-spec/blob/main/README.md) (checks, parity, golden twins), [graph schema](https://github.com/madfam-org/hyperobjects-spec/blob/main/src/y4d_spec/graph/graph.schema.json) (graph format 1.x), [ASSEMBLIES.md](https://github.com/madfam-org/hyperobjects-spec/blob/main/docs/ASSEMBLIES.md) (ASM-1, kinematics §9).
- solid-hyperobjects: [assemblies](https://github.com/madfam-org/solid-hyperobjects/blob/main/assemblies/README.md), mounted at `projects/`; forks are written to [user-projects storage](docs/operations/user-projects-storage.md). [Graph cartridges](docs/guides/graph-cartridges.md) covers the Studio graph editor.
- asset-shells: [README](https://github.com/madfam-org/asset-shells/blob/main/README.md) (shell store, twin graph).
- pravara-mes: [Sparkplug package](https://github.com/madfam-org/pravara-mes/blob/main/packages/sparkplug/README.md) (machine telemetry).

## Publication source acceptance

[Viewer resource ownership](docs/architecture/viewer-resource-ownership.md) documents the 32 MiB/16-entry CPU cache, per-consumer geometry, GLTF and animated-grid cleanup, and the limits of these budgets.

[Publication source acceptance](docs/operations/release-source-gate.md) describes the exact-main CI gate, stale-source pin refusal and runtime verification boundary.
